image_description: A white minibus (likely a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter or similar model) parked on a paved surface. The vehicle features a high roof, a row of side windows, and standard van wheels. There is a small logo on the front hood above the windshield. The background includes a building with some signage and greenery.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is visible, along with multiple side windows extending along the passenger cabin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.

The track for a sliding door is visible behind the front wheel arch, and the door panel lines are consistent with a sliding mechanism.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout typical of this class of vehicle.

Based on the window count and body length, the capacity aligns with the 4-10 passenger range defined for minibuses.

The emblem on the hood lacks sharp definition and appears slightly 'melted' or painterly compared to the crisp lines of the windshield wipers.
The connection point of the side mirror to the door frame is slightly ambiguous and lacks clear mechanical detail, though not structurally impossible.

To verify the spatial relationship between the vehicle and the background building, ensuring no floating elements or depth bleeding.
Wheels are high-risk areas for AI artifacts (fusion with ground, oval shapes). This expert will check for circular integrity and contact shadows.
To rigorously assess the legibility of the background text and the hood emblem, quantifying the 'gibberish' severity observed by the Router.
